subject: prd/implement-now
statement: implementing worker, reviewer child, or repository contributor seeking to manufacture review completion — vector: writes a schema-valid proposal comment before or after green, copies a prior proof, substitutes an artifact outside the broker receipt, or mutates/substitutes canonical obligation, attempt, or receipt state
intent: a proposal appears independently reviewed when no launched reviewer produced the accepted artifact
fit_criterion: FR-41 fresh attribution plus an impl-review-owned single-write broker; canonical review evidence producer-signing capability owned only by the executor-side evidence adapter and absent from every child process/workspace, so generic ref-write access has no semantic authority; FR-43 isolated reviewer workspace and one-way report handoff; UB-20 fail-closed classification; raw attribution material excluded from worker/repository/event surfaces
